description: Record the market into a local tape for paper_replay: the 1 m, 5 m, 1 h and 4 h candles of each market and its funding history, appended to what is already recorded. One call reaches about a day back on the 1 m band, so the tape grows by running this again over days. Nothing is signed and no key is read.

coins.description: The markets to record, comma separated (BTC,ETH); omit for the busiest ones

min_vlm.description: Only the markets with at least this much 24 h volume in USD (default 5000000)

top.description: How many markets to record, by 24 h volume (default 20)

name: paper_record
title: Record the market
